newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer, Unocal suit goes forward.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer, Unocal suit goes forward.

text.p: Pioneer Oil and Gas Wednesday said litigation between it and Unocal Corp over Pioneer's prior interest in the Santa Maria Valley unit started Monday after attempts to reach an out of court settlement failed.

Unocal is suing Pioneer over operations expenses and plugging, abandonment and cleanup costs in the amount of $800,000 and for a declaratory judgment to pay future cleanup costs estimated at another $800,000. Pioneer is counter-suing Unocal for alleged breach of fiduciary duty, under-pricing of crude oil, misallocation of expenses and concealment of revenues. Pioneer's counterclaim is for approximately $5 million.

Pioneer also announced that operations on the White River Dome have been delayed because of a temporary shortage of drilling rigs. It is anticipated that drilling operations will commence during March of 1997. Pioneer is also working on plans for a follow-up test at Maverick Springs.
